name: Pier
description: A man in his mid sixties, a weathered pier busker who plays for tips and sings steel-guitar Hawaiian swing.
build: A thin, slightly stooped adult build: narrow shoulders, a lean torso, wiry arms and long thin legs of ordinary proportion, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Leathery sun-darkened tan skin, pale blue eyes under shaggy white brows, a long nose, hollow cheeks and a short white stubble beard.
hair: Wispy white hair to the collar showing below the hat.
outfit: A battered wide-brimmed straw fedora with a faded navy band; a faded short-sleeved aloha shirt in deep navy with big bold white plumeria blooms, open over a white tank undershirt; black fingerless knit gloves leaving every fingertip bare; rolled tan chino trousers to mid-calf; worn brown leather sandals. Both hands are otherwise bare.
performance_style: Laid-back busker stance: feet together, weight on one hip, a slight forward stoop. Both arms relaxed, the character-right hand open at chest height as if on strings; the character-left hand open beside the thigh, fingertips visible. Head tipped, a gentle crooked smile.
location: An old wooden fishing pier at sunset: grey weathered planks running to the bottom of the frame, a wooden railing with a hanging life ring, gulls on the posts, and a coral-orange sun sinking into the sea.
recognition_cues: a navy aloha shirt with big white plumeria
avoid: a guitar or ukulele in the key art
a tip jar or hat at his feet

sing.intent: Hawaiian-swing vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, he sways slowly on a swing beat and strums the air gently with the character-left hand at the belly, then returns to the busker stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a loud beach sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back into the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: he shuffles in along the planks with an easy stroll, touches the hat brim with the character-left hand and settles into the busker stance.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: he sweeps the fedora off with the character-left hand in a slow gracious bow, straightens holding it to the chest with a warm open-mouthed laugh, and holds.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays on his feet while the energy drains out: the shoulders drop, both open hands hang limp at his sides, and his head hangs low with the chin toward the chest. He holds a standing, visibly deflated finish. He remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
